actual_path_query: SELECT s.specNumber,r.node_id,c.node_id,c.tdocNumber FROM Resolution r JOIN rel_REFERENCES rr ON rr.src_id=r.node_id JOIN CR c ON c.node_id=rr.dst_id JOIN rel_MODIFIES ms ON ms.src_id=c.node_id JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=ms.dst_id ORDER BY s.specNumber,r.node_id,c.node_id
independent_reconstruction: Python distinct identity sets from every actual inner-joined Resolution–CR–Spec path, separately enumerating the full Spec pool; does not read gold
question_en: Return the top 5 specs most modified via the resolution-to-CR-to-spec path (decision-driven change ranking).
